title: Remeasure Scope and Opening-Count Pricing
content:
# Remeasure Scope and Opening-Count Pricing

Estimating desk table for Window Replacement Contracts.

**Rule.** How the remeasure fee is figured depends on how many openings the most recent completed customer-requested remeasure covered: a remeasure of no more than the quick-check opening limit of 2 openings is charged the lesser of the series remeasure fee and the series missed-appointment fee; a remeasure of more than 2 openings but of fewer than half of the openings on the contract is charged the series remeasure fee times the openings remeasured divided by the openings on the contract; any other remeasure, covering half or more of the openings on the contract, is charged the series remeasure fee.

The openings remeasured are those recorded on that remeasure visit; the openings on the contract are the contract's opening count on record. The prorated figure is not rounded on its own; the remeasure fee is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Scope table

| Openings covered by the remeasure | Fee figured as |
|---|---|
| 1 or 2 | The lesser of the series remeasure fee and the series missed-appointment fee |
| 3 or more, and fewer than half of the openings on the contract | Series remeasure fee times openings remeasured, divided by openings on the contract |
| 3 or more, and half or more of the openings on the contract | Series remeasure fee, flat |

"Fewer than half" means twice the openings remeasured is less than the openings on the contract.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical series fee $100, missed-appointment fee $80)

| Contract openings | Openings remeasured | Fee figured as |
|---|---|---|
| 12 | 2 | $80.00, the lesser of $100 and $80 |
| 12 | 3 | $25.00 ($100 times 3, divided by 12) |
| 12 | 5 | $41.666…, rounded to $41.67 at the end |
| 12 | 6 | $100.00 (exactly half) |
| 4 | 3 | $100.00 (more than half) |
